# Version 4.152.0
> **Graphite and Vulkan expansion** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0-preview)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

The 4.152.0 preview adds Graphite GPU backend bindings and a new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package. Also fixes two native use-after-free bugs in SKRegion and SKPixmap, adds backend-neutral async pixel readback, and bumps to Chrome milestone m152.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Bumped to Chrome milestone m152** — Updates the bundled engine to Chrome milestone m152 and merges upstream chrome/m151 stability fixes along the way. ([#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4537](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4537))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend bindings added** — Adds Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, alongside a new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package with Vulkan tests running on Android and Linux. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968), [#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))
- **Backend-neutral async pixel readback** — Adds RequestReadPixels to SKImage and SKSurface for backend-neutral asynchronous pixel reads. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native use-after-free fixes** — Fixes a native use-after-free in SKRegion.SpanIterator by rooting the owning SKRegion, and a similar use-after-free in SKPixmap.ExtractSubset and its With* methods by rooting the pixel source. Also fixes a CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak on the SKImage.Create raster failure path. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558), [#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))
- **FreeType-based font support on Nano Server** — Uses FreeType for font support on Nano Server, where the platform font stack is unavailable. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Interop and uniform-lookup performance improved** — Caches the HandleDictionary skip-registration reflection check, pre-sizes the SKRuntimeEffectUniforms lookup map to its known count, and avoids an intermediate string allocation in the null-terminated GetEncodedText path. ([#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512), [#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498))
- **Deterministic binding generation** — Makes binding generation deterministic across platforms, avoiding spurious diffs between build machines. ([#4612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4612))

## Platform

- **New containerized test legs** — Adds containerized test legs for Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, and Nano Server, and converts all .sln solutions to the .slnx format. ([#4515](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4515), [#4528](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4528))
- **Windows native build environment fix** — Initializes the MSVC environment once per native build and stops pinning a default Windows SDK version. — ❤️ [@mmitche](https://github.com/mmitche) ([#4570](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4570), [#4588](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4588))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

No binding-facing changes; the HarfBuzzSharp build now shares the converted .slnx solutions and the new containerized test legs.

## Preview 1 (August 5, 2026)

Opened the 4.152.0 line with the Graphite GPU backend bindings, the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package, the SKRegion and SKPixmap use-after-free fixes, and the initial m152 Skia sync.
